title: The 'Your gym is ready' card is only checked for its title and Done button
what: Every online-gym test passes the card by checking its title and first sentence, then pressing Done. Nothing checks the gym code, the join link, the QR, the copy messages, the share or WhatsApp step, the poster button, or that an ordinary sign-in shows no card.
expected: A screen test reads the code and link on the card, copies each, presses the poster button and signs in again to see no card.
fix_line: Add one screen test for the card's code, link, copy, share and poster steps

title: The brand-new gym numbers journey expects five zero tiles, but the panel hides them
what: The journey says a gym with no members sees all five tiles at zero and the empty-list words. The panel hides the numbers until the first record, and a test checks exactly that, so the journey's first step can never be seen.
expected: The journey and the screen agree: either the journey says the tiles are hidden until the first record, or the panel shows them.
fix_line: Fix the journey to match the hidden tiles, then test the empty-list words

title: The Today cards for numbers to confirm and app plan requests are never used on screen
what: The words, the error sentences and the server rules of both cards are tested, but no test opens Today with a waiting number or a pause or renew request and presses Yes, No, Approve or Decline. 'Saving…', the buttons switching off, the row leaving, the Needs you count dropping and the card hiding are never seen.
expected: One screen test per card answers a waiting row as the owner and checks the row, the count and the card.
fix_line: Add a screen test that answers one waiting number and one plan request

title: Marking and taking back a PT session is never done on screen
what: The session rules are tested as data and on the server, but no screen test presses Mark session or Undo. 'PT session marked.', 'Session marked today', '2 PT packs running…', the 'Only 1 PT session left' words and the Undo button being hidden from the desk for an older day are never checked.
expected: A screen test marks a session, sees the count go up and the button turn off, undoes it, and checks the desk sees no Undo for an older day.
fix_line: Add a screen test for Mark session and Undo on a PT member

title: The empty Pass visits page and the one-visit export words are never checked
what: The pass test checks a month with two visits and 'Exported 2 pass visits.'. Nothing checks the words for one visit, the empty month words, or that a gym with no pass members has no Pass visits entry. No test does a pass visit as the front desk.
expected: A test checks 'Exported 1 pass visit.', the empty month words and the hidden entry.
fix_line: Add the one-visit and empty-month checks to the pass test
